title: Кібератака на державні організації України з використанням теми ОК "Південь" та шкідливої програми AgentTesla (CERT-UA#4987)

entities.name: Доповідь_050722_4.ppt
entities.gloss: A malicious PowerPoint presentation file used as a lure to trigger a malware infection chain.

entities.name: оперативне командування "Південь"
entities.gloss: An operational command formation of the Ukrainian Ground Forces.

entities.name: Україна
entities.gloss: A sovereign country in Eastern Europe whose state organizations were targeted.

entities.name: gksg023ig.lnk
entities.gloss: A malicious shortcut file created by the presentation macro to execute an executable file.

entities.name: sgegkseg23mjl.exe
entities.gloss: An obfuscated .NET executable that downloads a steganographic image file to unpack next-stage malware.

entities.name: rundll32.exe
entities.gloss: A standard Windows utility used to execute program code and launch shortcut files.

entities.name: ConfuserEx
entities.gloss: An open-source protector and obfuscator designed for .NET applications.

entities.name: thumb_d_F3D14F4982A256B5CDAE9BD579429AE7.jpg
entities.gloss: A JPEG image file containing encrypted and compressed payload data.

entities.name: MCMDiction.exe
entities.gloss: A .NET executable extracted from an image file that executes the final stealer payload.

entities.name: AgentTesla
entities.gloss: An advanced spyware and infostealer malware family capable of capturing keystrokes, credentials, and screenshots.

entities.name: tesla.exe
entities.gloss: A compiled executable file containing the AgentTesla malware.

entities.name: onyangdol.site
entities.gloss: A domain name used to host a malicious payload file disguised as a JPEG.

entities.name: ftp.artrsllc.com
entities.gloss: An FTP domain name identified as network infrastructure in the incident.

entities.name: https://onyangdol.site/thumb_d_F3D14F4982A256B5CDAE9BD579429AE7.jpg
entities.gloss: A web URL used to host and distribute a malicious JPEG payload.

entities.name: ftp://ftp.artrsllc.com/
entities.gloss: An FTP URL identified as network infrastructure in the attack.
